column1: # A rule not listed here keeps ZAP's default. The run fails on any finding of
# Medium risk or above (see .zap/judge.py), whatever is listed here, unless the
# rule is IGNORE. IGNORE only a finding that has been triaged, and give the
# reason in a comment above it: this file is the record of accepted risk.
# Informational: ZAP notes that the site is a single-page app whose links
# are built by JavaScript. A description, not a weakness.
# Informational: "Cache-Control: no-cache" on HTML is deliberate. It makes
# the browser revalidate the page, so a deploy is picked up at once, while the
# hashed files under /assets are cached for a year (frontend/public/_headers).
# Informational: "storable and cacheable content". Deliberate: the hashed
# files under /assets are cached for a year, and nothing personal is ever
# served from them (API responses go through the proxy, not this cache rule).
